verdict.rationale: WooCommerce documents a public Store API built for customer-facing cart, checkout and product features. It covers listing and filtering products, turning a cart into an order, collecting addresses and handling payment, which is the core of a custom headless storefront. The REST API and an official JavaScript library add a JSON CRUD backend layer. Missing for 10: a first-party headless frontend framework or starter kit, independent or hands-on corroboration of headless builds, a published OpenAPI spec (probe found none), and documentation detail on headless session/auth handling.
